operations.algorithm: Require PNH1/version1 and exactly318 bytes; decode the twelve fixed fields at the published offsets; compute challenge only from those bytes; no field normalization.
operations.commit: None; codec has no database.

operations.algorithm: Read 95-byte prefix, match exact tag-specific payload length and bounded proof/list count, require nonce>0 and fee cap, then separate final64 signature bytes. Signature verification belongs to admission.
operations.commit: None; decode success cannot reserve nonce or funds.
operations.limits: 12 closed native tags; sorted unique allocation IDs

operations.algorithm: Check length/magic/field bounds; recompute TaskId; apply cheap ticket filter; replay challenge-noised tiled transcript and exact decoded product; return no verified type on any mismatch.
operations.commit: No authoritative store; cache key must include complete context.
operations.errors: LENGTH, VERSION, TASK, FIELD, TARGET, TRANSCRIPT, PRODUCT

operations.algorithm: Strict Ed25519 over H(tx-sign,unsigned). Reject weak/malformed keys or mismatching signatures before copying mutations into a committed state. Signed scores remain attestations, not work.
operations.commit: No key material copied from fixtures into deployment.
operations.limits: one signature per tx; quota use adds one consumer signature

operations.inputs: header, ordered tx bytes, full certificate, observed local time
operations.algorithm: Resolve parent, exact height/target/median/profile and parent-admitted task; verify real work and all signatures; execute and compare state/receipt/tx roots; derive required work; persist only complete valid block.
operations.commit: Single block+deltas transaction owned by M07; no partial accepted header.
operations.errors: UNKNOWN_PARENT, TIME, TARGET, WORK, ROOT, LIMIT

operations.inputs: fully validated tips and active tip
operations.output: strictly heavier target or unchanged active
operations.algorithm: Compare derived cumulative required work; ignore invalid/unavailable branches; equal work retains current tip. Pass exact old/new roots and generation to M08; never alter application state in a fork selector.
operations.commit: M08 publishes active pointer only after staged-root readback.
operations.limits: max4096 reference ancestry; production streaming sync separate

operations.inputs: frozen header,parent generation, task matrices, attempt budget
operations.output: exact proof or explicit stale/cancelled attempt
operations.algorithm: Freeze all header bytes before work; evaluate full challenge transcript; retry a different nonce with a new computation; cap local reference attempts4096. Parent changes do not relabel an old transcript. Durable mining-attempt recovery is a native integration obligation, not implemented by the CLI.
operations.commit: Reference mining is in-memory; no claim of durable miner. External publication uses exact idempotent BlockId.
operations.limits: 49188-byte result, bounded matrix sizes; no hidden success fallback

operations.output: unique entered fact or replay/revoke failure
operations.algorithm: Check revocation; insert exact operation once into independent effects DB before actual dispatch. A reorg never deletes this record. Duplicate entry queries/reconciles target; it cannot dispatch again.
operations.commit: Separate SQLite WAL FULL DB, PK operation; independent anchor not yet joined.
operations.limits: fixed operation and payload digests; one local owner

operations.output: bounded exact message or transport error
operations.algorithm: Read four bytes with10-second timeout; require 1..2097152 before allocating; read exactly length and reject duplicate JSON keys. Submit payload goes through full M02 validation, never through an accept flag.
operations.commit: Transport has no chain authority; each child owns a different ledger.

operations.inputs: fixed header,txs,certificate and three peer endpoints
operations.algorithm: Send identical block to separate processes; each rechecks full work and state before ack. Retain failed/unavailable outcomes. Native peer identity/replay comes from retained authenticated frame components, not the test TCP wrapper.
operations.commit: M07/M08 own receipt persistence; transport never writes ledger tables.

operations.inputs: active snapshot, signed envelope, candidate height
operations.algorithm: Require exact network, signature, nonce=current+1, height<=expiry and sufficient fee/funds before applying command. Invalid input leaves the original parent unchanged; decoded bytes are not reserved balance.
operations.commit: M06 returns a new state; only M07 can commit it.

operations.inputs: old included tx, new active generation, local effect id
operations.output: new admissible intent or reconciliation requirement
operations.algorithm: Invalidate branch-relative inclusion; rerun nonce/grant/funds checks against new state. Never replay an irreversible operation because chain nonce vanished. Native mempool event wiring remains integration work.
operations.commit: Persistent local effect tombstones stay outside chain undo.

operations.output: next map, ordered receipts, state root
operations.algorithm: Run deterministic due expiry and maturity before txs; execute exactly12 closed commands; transfer exact fees, stage subsidy; verify global conservation and size bounds. Remote calls, floats and evaluator programs never run inside state transition.
operations.commit: Return complete state/delta intent; caller M07 owns persistence.
operations.errors: EVIDENCE, AUTHORITY, STATE, FUNDS, CONSERVATION, LIMIT

operations.algorithm: For sorted union of keys compare canonical values; emit only changed entries, encode absence as NULL and empty value as real bytes. Detach verifies after then restores before; attach checks before then writes after.
operations.commit: Same atomic commit as admitted block row.
operations.limits: keys160bytes,values4096bytes; no copied state claimed high throughput

operations.algorithm: Reject directory/database symlinks; obtain nonblocking exclusive owner lock; open WAL FULL; require exact stored parameter commitment; initialize genesis only in an empty new namespace.
operations.commit: Tables and keys are fixed in S1; no implicit old-store migration.
operations.limits: one process writer, SQLite10-second lock timeout

operations.inputs: fully verified block and before/after map
operations.output: atomic block row plus exact deltas
operations.algorithm: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, insert immutable block, insert changed-key deltas, COMMIT. Any failure rolls back the transaction. A restart reads complete old/new state, not partially visible rows.
operations.commit: blocks+deltas one transaction; active pointer separate M08 publication.

operations.inputs: old/new validated tips and active generation
operations.algorithm: Find common ancestor; detach descending old branch and attach ascending new branch. Copy old generation to fresh staging generation and commit exact intent/position0. If pending, resume the same intent before new work.
operations.commit: BEGIN IMMEDIATE: staged kv+reorg row; public active unchanged.
operations.limits: bounded retained ancestry; no local depth as permanent finality

operations.output: new coherent active root and unique events
operations.algorithm: Apply each step+cursor atomically with expected-value checks; verify full target root; publish active pointer, ordered events and done atomically. Repeat recovery is idempotent; local external facts are not undone.
operations.commit: Eight named process-crash cuts; read transaction sees whole old or new generation.

operations.algorithm: Read at most65537 bytes; require <=65536 and canonical JSON byte identity, exact fields/shapes/ranges/feature/family. Hash bytes, never mutable path names. No executable object format.
operations.commit: Content-addressed artifact and manifest owned by the artifact provider.

operations.algorithm: Verify each copy hash; remove original author path during controlled test; load from a custodian and bind actual model hash to result. Remote diversified storage and long-term repair are not implied by local copies.
operations.commit: Retention obligations separate from self-contained historical work certificates.

operations.algorithm: Recompute full id; require exact family/current parent and artifact size; reject same parent/artifact duplicates even under another sender; status submitted. A signature is provenance claim, not model merit.
operations.commit: Deterministic contribution/duplicate rows commit with block.

operations.inputs: evaluated bundle,sorted scored leaf list,sponsor budget
operations.algorithm: Verify bundle minimum positive score; bind exact components root, accepted leaf scores/owners and total; recompute release id; debit sponsor; record maturity and claims; only then adopt pointer. Local Hepta use still requires generation admission.
operations.commit: Same state transition and block delta; reorg reverses pointer/escrow but not historical inference.

operations.algorithm: Use exact model inference and paired sign rule: n>=20,w>l,20*binomialtail<=2^m; score=floor((w-l)*1e6/n), else0. Record every baseline including stronger single experts; no score tuning after observation.
operations.commit: Immutable evidence bytes; durations outside consensus values.

operations.output: one attestation or frozen evaluated result
operations.algorithm: Require one of three named development evaluators, not author, unique sender, expected plan and nonzero evidence. First2 valid attestations freeze minimum score; no extra votes change it. This admits attestation truth, not objectively recomputed ML correctness.
operations.commit: Votes embedded in contribution state; no chainwork or validationmembership mutation.

operations.algorithm: Check maturity, ownership, unclaimed leaf and exact proofdepth; verify root; pay floor(originalbudget*score/acceptedtotal); mark nullifier and decrement remaining. New transactionnonce cannot replay a claimed contribution.
operations.commit: Reward and account mutations are branch state; external delivery is independent.

operations.algorithm: Verify bound provider, deadline, positiveunits, prepaidfunds and consumer signature over provider nonce. Debit prepaid units*1024, pay fee and provider, leave consumer balance untouched. It does not imply learning/export permission.
operations.commit: Atomic nativecommand transition; effects journal separately records actual delivery.
operations.limits: max1millionunits; pre-reservedquota; no unlimited free-service obligation

operations.output: exact branch map/root or explicit failure
operations.algorithm: Walk parent links to genesis within referencebound; replay sorted deltas verifying each before value and block root. Existing local authenticated storage is the premise; untrusted network imports must first pass full block admission.
operations.commit: Reconstructed state is checked before active publication; no unauthenticated snapshot trust.

operations.algorithm: For each block use M02 exact parent work and M06 state validation. Work matrices/certificate remain self-contained; model retention is separate. Never interpret a local checkpoint or old proof as a new finality certificate.
operations.commit: Append valid branch rows/deltas only; incomplete import not active.
operations.limits: block1MiB; bounded proof jobs; no permanent pruning-depth fork rejection

operations.inputs: active generation and optional event cursor
operations.algorithm: Read active pointer and generation kv in one snapshot and recompute root; return no unconditional finalized flag. A production confirmation adds depth/work evidence and freshness; localhost ACK is not independent proof.
operations.commit: Indexer is derived; cursor(generation,ordinal), no new balanceauthority.

operations.output: bound inference result and optional signedusage receipt
operations.algorithm: Fetch exact canonical artifact, check all fields/shapes; execute integer router/base/expert; persist actual model/request identity before usage settlement. No data export follows automatically from free usage.
operations.commit: Local modelgeneration and effect owner remain Hepta responsibilities.
operations.limits: 65536artifactbytes experimental; no reducedmodel hidden behind fullprofile

operations.algorithm: Acquire exclusive store owner, verify parameters, recover unfinishedintent, then bind127.0.0.1 and announcegenesis. No network admission before recovery. This is not the native production node assembly.
operations.commit: Own one ledger writer perprocess; private directory; current schemaonly.

operations.algorithm: Stop admission, requestchild stop, wait bounded5seconds, kill+reap ifunresponsive; retain DB intent and local effect identity. No global service or external credentials are touched.
operations.commit: Child owner acquired immediately; finally paths clean startedchildren.

operations.algorithm: Use explicit full-batch softmax recipe,120stepslocal androuter, inverseclassfrequency, boundedquantization; selectroutertargets on calibration only. Emitnewimmutableartifact, never mutate activebundle.
operations.commit: Training records owned by localproducer; chain receives only parameter/evidenceclaims.

operations.algorithm: Measure wholemodel and ablations on fixedpartitions; zero when gainrulefails; preservefirstfailedexperiment and strongerbaselines. Proposal cannot change consensus,target,evaluatorprofile or localpermissions.
operations.commit: No chainwrite until explicit M10 signedproposal and M11 evidence.

operations.commit: Read-only checker; no evidence outcome mutation.
